newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Coffee seen sideways, upside limited.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Coffee seen sideways, upside limited.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Coffee futures are likely to stay sideways in a tight range as upward potential seemed limited, technical anlaysts said on Friday.
Traders called the market to open unchanged.
Susan Rigg, an analyst at Chart Analysis, said coffee had a good rally when it failed to break the $1,500 level on the way down recently.
"It's coming back to the $1,600 area and just above it but the upward movement is not marked by strong dynamics although it has slight upward bias," she said.
"However, the upward progress could be a struggle," she added. "It will probably trade sideways."
In fundamental news, the Brazilian soluble industry can import coffee if it wants, Industry and Commerce Minister Francisco Dornelles said.

Brazil's soluble industry has been pressing the government to release stocks to it so it can meet production demand. It has put off a project to import coffee while the government studies the stock-lending proposal.

But the proposal to lend stocks to the soluble industry, recently trumpeted as a done deal, has apparently come unstuck as the Ministry of Industry and Commerce and the Finance Ministry battle over it. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
